about: The manifests of escouade-plugin.json and what their reader says of them (ESC-173). Both readers go through every case: the app's (src-tauri/src/plugins/manifest_tests.rs) and the store's library (schemas/plugin-manifest.test.ts). `errors` are `<path> <code>`, in any order; `ignored` the unknown fields, which load nothing and fail nothing; `reserved` (none when absent) the reserved points declared (`menus`, `statusBar`, `badges`, `projectTemplates`, `escouadeYml`, ESC-524), said by `validate` as a warning, never a refusal. `files` are the files of the plugin's folder a case reads (its `icon`): `png` a PNG's header of that width and height, padded to `size` bytes; `text` a file of that text.
